notes.title: Put the kettle on it's update time!
notes.notes: Howdy! Steam achievements have gone live with the recent patch. In addition to Steam achievements, Odin's Tea Party has also received several updates and improvements, including bug fixes, gameplay tweaks, and improved performance! Oh look the water has just boiled better start brewing the perfect cup of tea to serve to Odin and his guests.

notes.title: Odin's Tea Party Demo small update!
notes.notes:
Howdy! I'd recently updated the Odin's Tea Party demo with a new soundtrack, optimisation and a handful of bug fixes. If you haven't tried out the demo yet you are more than welcome to have a lil look around. 

The full release of Odin's Tea Party is just around the corner (6th December ːlunar2019piginablanketː ) hope to see yah there!
